description: Four source packages provide monthly facility royalty-trigger factors and meter-station ties for post-registry production. They form one named reporting series. Listed PDF components span November 2017 through July 2025. The package titled 2018–2022 includes two 2017 months; the 2023 package metadata ends in April although descriptors extend through December. Those metadata differences remain explicit. This information describes facility-to-meter relationships and associated royalty factors, without implying a complete hydraulic network, flow measurements or machine-readable tables. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
